## Release Notes

### Cause & Parking Logic
- **#3759**: Default park ladder for spent shared causes; after two failures, claude_opus attempts once with prior_attempts, then parks with file_cause_ticket (no escalate_operator). Park ends when base_heads differs from parked_base_head.
- **#2977**: Scheduled job re-mints OCC companions conflicted by sibling landings on onex_change_control dev.

### Snapshot & Projection Fixes
- **#3224**: TableRowSource reads live columns once (to_regclass cached) and keys only on declared columns the relation carries, fixing 503 projection_column_missing on six snapshot exposures.
- **#1805**: onex-work-ledger gains --source projection|local|auto; auto folds projection plus local tail, falls back to local-only on fault, never CLEAR on missing buffer.
- **#3682**: PR-state schema v2 adds per-check facts (check, conclusion, run_id, workflow, completed_at) for red contexts; ModelCiRunFailedEvent gains failing_runs, base_red_checks, base_read.

### Validator & Check-Compute Conversions
- **#1889**: Converts first omnibase_core validator batch to node_<rule>_check_compute packages emitting ModelValidationReport with golden verdict-parity tests; switches pre-commit and CI to them.
- **#1394**: Fixes false-green in three no-* validators (validate_no_except_swallow, validate_no_import_none_fallback, validate_no_none_guard_publish) by parsing flags vs paths and failing closed on empty scope.
- **#1583**: Adds ENVIRONMENT to EnumDependencyType and typed env_var to ModelDependency; _batch_convert_dict_dependencies reads env_var and accepts contract-native type: key when value names an enum member.
- **#1796**: canonical_handler_shape classifier now resolves inherited handle() methods, fixing misclassification of classes like HandlerPrLifecycleFixRuntime.

### CI & Workflow Improvements
- **#1392**: Removes merge_group trigger from 22 non-required workflows (call-occ-preflight, check-handshake, handshake-policy-gate, receipt-honesty, 18 validator-*) on omnibase_core; pull_request and push triggers untouched.
- **#1395**: Removes 7 duplicate/superseded jobs from omni-standards-compliance.yml (naming-conventions, node-purity-check, etc.), keeps 5 unique jobs.
- **#354**: Adds call-repo-evidence-gate.yml in omnibase_spi triggering on pull_request_target; calls omnibase_core receipt-gate.yml at pinned SHA with evidence-source caller, verifier-version 0.4.305.
- **#1234**: Adds 33 protocol-conformance tests verifying transport-surface Protocols work as AsyncMock/MagicMock spec=; fixes transport_mock_lint.py --write-baseline to emit portable relative paths via _rel_path.

### Dependency Updates
- **#329**: Bumps OmniNode-ai/omniclaude/.github/workflows/hardcoded-model-config-reusable.yml from 1ad181a3… to be0f2414….
- **#245**: Bumps actions/cache from 5 to 6 (semver-major).
- **#1119**: Bumps OmniNode-ai/onex_change_control in actions group from 32a57e7b… to 9f92bbeb….

### Security & Gate Enhancements
- **#1837**: Adds node_direct_model_call_check_compute (contract.yaml, handler.py, models.py, policy.yaml, runtime_direct_model_call.py) with check-direct-model-call hook; consumers maintain shrink-only baseline in .onex_ratchets/direct_model_call_baseline.yaml.
- **#1821**: URL Authority Gate AST pass now detects os.getenv, from os import environ/getenv (aliased), import os as <alias>, and keys resolved through string constants/attributes; adds _DSN name shape.
- **#1953**: Retires skip-token approvals registry; receipt gate rejects every skip token regardless of context; removes allowlist loader, expiry, scope, self-approval checks, workflow argument, grant script.
- **#3634**: Adds node_handshake_policy_gate_effect (contract.yaml, HandlerHandshakePolicyGateRun, models, ports, GitHub REST adapter, CLI); reads default branch and latest check-handshake.yml run, sleeps between retries.

### Model & API Integrations
- **#3141**: Adds free glm-4.5-flash rung on z.ai general API under cheap_cloud with own quota domain; loader refuses paid IDs; zero-price model booked free; general-API surface declared in own contract.

### Performance & Lazy Loading
- **#1918**: Lazy-loads omnibase_core runtime/, event_bus/, models/, protocols/ package inits (174 __init__.py files); cuts hook import time from ~1 s to ~0.09 s for RuntimeLocal with inmemory bus.

### Protocol & SPI Enhancements
- **#87**: Implements ProtocolNodeProjectionEffect as synchronous ProtocolEffect (execute() must be synchronous); adds ProtocolEffect, ProtocolNodeProjectionEffect, ContractProjectionResult contracts for projection writes before Kafka publish.
- **#310**: dispatch() and dispatch_with_transaction() gain optional keyword-only delivery parameter defaulting to None; preserves structural validity for pre-existing implementors and callers.

### Local Runtime & Tooling
- **#2965**: onex local init writes runtime.lane example document (mode 0600) and sets config_source: local-home in ~/.onex/config.yaml; module at src/omnimarket/models/model_local_runtime_lane.py with 24 tests.
- **#3155**: Drops two dead mypy overrides; node_navigation_history_reducer now stores ModelONEXContainer directly; adds contract FSM test for 'reduced' state.
- **#3041**: delegation_events gains nullable ticket_id with partial index; HandlerDelegationTicketFold returns column for well-formed ticket, nothing for absent, named refusal for malformed.
- **#2988**: Declares classify_head_checks operation on node_pr_lifecycle_triage_compute (contract 1.1.0) with ModelHeadCheckFacts, ModelHeadCheckVerdict, EnumHeadCheckVerdict; 48 hand-labelled PR heads from 2026-09-26 corpus.
- **#3515**: Re-binds AC3 to -k s6_cutover (was compares_with_occ); adds AC4–AC6 bound to new data file and test (count bar 30, 13 case observations).

### Release
- **#1702**: Releases omnibase_core 0.47.17 (dev already at this version); changelog entry carries no ticket reference per check-doc-content-scan gate.
